title: Yahoo has a single Spam folder, but Thunderbird shows 2 for Yahoo
creator: JandNL
content:
Hello,

I hope you're doing well.

I noticed that in Thunderbird, my Yahoo account has both a Bulk and a Junk Spam folder. My Yahoo account online and in the app only shows one Spam folder for all such messages.

How can I ensure that I only have a single Spam folder, as is normal? I want to keep mail organization as simple as possible.

Thanks in advance!

title: Não consigo anexar arquivos nas mensagens do Thunderbid
creator: jjjluis9
content: Estou usando o Thunderbird 140.17.0esr (64 bits) do Linux Debian 13 com KDE. Estou com um problema que não consigo anexar arquivo nas mensagens. Quando click no icone de anexo, ele não abre a tela para anexar. Já desinstalei e reinstalei o Thunderbird tanto via flatpak, quando normal e o problema continua. Percebi que mesmo fazendo o backup do perfil ele volta quando coloco o perfil do backup.
